verdict: Leads dropped and cost per lead rose; intake pipeline needs immediate attention.
narrative: Over the last 28 days you received 87 leads at an average cost of $23.95 per lead, but this past week lead volume fell 26% while cost per lead jumped 32% on nearly the same spend — a clear sign that the primary Meta campaign has been running long enough for its creative to lose effectiveness. Separately, 71 contacts arrived over the period yet zero have moved into your intake pipeline, meaning leads are coming in but not being followed up in a way the system can track; that is a follow-up process issue, not an ads issue. Google Business Profile activity also dropped sharply this week, and we are confirming whether that reflects a real visibility dip or a tracking gap. Ad creative is being refreshed this week to arrest the cost-per-lead rise, and the intake flow is being reviewed so arriving leads move forward.
